section_summary.extract_value: This Results section (4.2) reports random assignment checks using ANOVAs to assess whether trait levels of key variables differed between experimental conditions. Body anxiety trait levels significantly varied between health and appearance conditions, with health conditions showing higher anxiety (M = 2.87, SD = 1.09) than appearance conditions (M = 2.40, SD = 0.98). No other covariates (age, BMI, health/appearance goals, introjected regulation) showed significant differences between conditions.
